scope: Diagnostic-only allocator trim at 250 ms after GPU activation; no renderer/allocator policy change. Each ABBA stage uses one binary and disabled shader disk caches. Allocator counters are not PSS or allocation-owner attribution; mapping classes contain no addresses or filenames. External before_trim sampling is earlier than the operation and can include unrelated deferred initialization. Normal-cache observations are separate cases.
